title: GitHub 'Get a commit' returns only the first 300 files; PyGithub Commit.files silently capped at 300
symptom: len(commit.files) == 300 for a commit with 926 changed files; no error
contract_property: pagination completeness: follow Link rel=next until absent; files count must equal commit stats when available
provider_evidence_quote: the response will include pagination link headers for the remaining files, up to a limit of 3000 files.
spec_visible_rationale: Pagination is signalled by Link headers and a prose note; the response schema is unchanged.
verification: issue + PR fetched via GitHub API; doc note fetched
notes: Report-to-fix ~3.5 years.

title: GitHub 'Compare two commits' silently limited to 250 commits without paging params

spec_visible_rationale: Limit is in prose, not in the schema.
verification: doc fetched; no client bug located (WebSearch budget exhausted)
notes: Provider-documented trap; client bug not yet found [verify].

title: GitHub Contents API returns content "" and encoding "none" for files >= 1 MB; github-mcp-server mishandled it

provider_evidence_quote: the content field will be an empty string and the encoding field will be "none".
replayable_offline: yes (PR adds test with real response shape)
spec_visible_rationale: Field types unchanged (string); emptiness is size-dependent behavior.
notes: Silent at the API, loud in this client version (regression in v1.10.0).

title: GitHub silently ignores requested labels when caller lacks permission; issue_write reported success

spec_visible_rationale: Permission-dependent behavior; schema identical.
notes: Fix compares requested vs returned labels: exactly a fiks-style postcondition.

title: Stripe ISK and UGX must be sent as two-decimal values although they are zero-decimal (100x unit trap)

spec_visible_rationale: amount is an integer in every version; unit rule lives in prose.
notes: HUF/TWD payouts must be divisible by 100. Closest real analog to seeded D1.
